brand_rules.mission: Upgrade aquarium keeping in Iraq from random trial-and-error into professional care with trusted tools and real knowledge.
brand_rules.positioning: The expert Iraqi aquarium store for hobbyists tired of weak products and wrong advice; teach first, sell the right solution second.

voice.tone: Expert, calm, confident, premium, never desperate
voice.emoji_rule: Zero emoji in public captions, prompts, and on-image text
voice.cta_rule: Avoid hard-sell lines. Stories must not ask for comments and must not show manual sticker UI. Feed posts/carousels can use calm engagement. No visible logo, website URL, company name, QR code, watermark, brand badge, or bottom signature inside generated images.

colors.rule: Dark mode only, never white as primary background, never more than three active colors in one design.

photography.background: Dark slate, dark walnut, #0A1628, or real aquarium image with 70% dark overlay
photography.lighting: Warm amber side light from left + cool cyan rim light from right
photography.composition: Rule of thirds; product on intersection point where possible
photography.grade: Moody Aquatic: deep blue/teal shadows, warm amber highlights, -10% general saturation, cyan/green boost, +15% contrast, 5-8% film grain, light vignette
photography.forbidden: White plastic background, direct flash, cold fluorescent lighting, random angles, oversaturated filters

social_templates.story_reel: 1080x1920; hook white, body #199BB8, CTA #FF7B5A; no visible logo or bottom signature
social_templates.closing_screen: #0A1628 background with simple fade only; no logo, no wordmark, no bottom signature

motion.closing: fade to dark background without any logo or wordmark
